description: This file defines the AppConfigDataClient class in the AWS SDK for PHP, which interacts with the AWS AppConfig Data service. It includes method annotations for core operations like retrieving the latest configuration and starting configuration sessions, both synchronously and asynchronously.

classes.name: AppConfigDataClient
classes.description: A client class extending AwsClient, specifically for interacting with the AWS AppConfig Data service.

methods.name: getLatestConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves the latest configuration from AWS AppConfig Data.

methods.name: startConfigurationSession
methods.description: Starts a new configuration session with AWS AppConfig Data.

methods.name: startConfigurationSessionAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously starts a new configuration session.
